timestamp.description:
The timestamp to query the features at. This matters for fields such as {@link FeatureFetchBase#value}.
If not set, the current time is used.

featureNames.description: The names of the features that data should be retrieved for.

assetId.description: The id of the asset that the features are associated with.

isValidation.description:
If true, model validation types should be queried. Otherwise, normal model types should be queried.

More specifically, if true, a {@link ReliabilityAssetToModelValidationRelation} instance should be
the source of truth. If false, a {@link ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation} instance should be the source of truth.

include.description:
The fields to include for each feature returned. See {@link FeatureFetchBaseSpec#fetchSpec}'s for more details.
It should match the requirements of the `include` parameter of `fetchSpec`.

title:
Contains all the options required to query feature data without mimicking the behavior of {@link Persistable#fetch}.
This is the spec for the {@link FeatureFetchBase#getAllFeatures} method.
name: FeatureFetchBaseGetFeaturesSpec
